name: G2RL-1-E DC24
title: G2RL low-profile PCB power relay, 1 or 2 poles, up to 16 A
summary: G2RL is a family of through-hole power relays 15.7 mm tall with DC coils of 5, 12, 24 or 48 V, made as SPST-NO, SPDT, DPST-NO and DPDT. Standard 1-pole models carry 12 A, 2-pole 8 A, high-capacity (-E) 16 A and high-sensitivity (-H, 250 mW coil) 10 A, all with 440 VAC / 300 VDC maximum switching voltage, 5,000 VAC coil-to-contact dielectric strength and 8 mm clearance and creepage. The G2RL-1-E DC24 is the 16 A SPDT high-capacity model with a 24 VDC, 1,440 Ω coil. -PW1 models accept a reduced holding voltage or PWM coil drive, -CV models switch at 105 °C, and -HA models meet IEC/EN 60335-1.
key_figures: 16 A at 250 VAC, 16 A at 24 VDC (resistive)

notes: The full order code is the model followed by the coil voltage, for example G2RL-1-E DC24 (24 VDC coil). The case itself is marked with the coil voltage in the form nnVDC.
Orders are placed in whole tubes of 20 pieces.
Sealed models: contact OMRON sales.

Model code fields, in order after G2RL-: poles (1 or 2); contact form (blank = changeover SPDT/DPDT, A = make-only NO); enclosure (blank = flux protection, 4 = sealed); classification (blank = standard, E = high-capacity, H = high-sensitivity); contact material (blank = Ag alloy, Cd free; ASI = AgSnIn); special requirement 1 (CV = 16 A, 5 mm pinning, switching at 105 °C); market code (blank = general purpose, HA = home appliance to IEC/EN 60335-1); special requirement 2 (PW1 = coil holding-voltage and PWM drive type).

circuits.title: Example of drive circuit (PWM coil drive, -PW1 models)
circuits.description: Low-side PWM drive for a -PW1 relay coil. One end of the coil sits on the coil supply at rated voltage (100%); an n-channel MOSFET takes the other end to ground under a pulse train on its gate. A surge absorption diode lies across the coil, cathode on the supply side, anode on the MOSFET drain. OMRON's verified conditions: rated voltage applied, duty 60% or more, frequency 10 kHz or more, diode Vf 0.4 V or less.

parts.note: relay coil, pins 1 and 8; the contact pins carry the load and are outside this circuit

notes: At pick-up the coil gets full rated voltage for 100 ms or more before the PWM holding drive starts.

operation.text: G2RL is a family of PCB power relays 15.7 mm tall. It comes as one-pole or two-pole, make-only or changeover, in standard, 16 A high-capacity and 250 mW high-sensitivity versions. Clearance and creepage are 8 mm / 8 mm min. -HA models conform to IEC/EN 60335-1, and -CV models run at ambient temperatures up to 105 °C. G2RL-1(A)-E-ASI models carry a TV3 rating. The family conforms to IEC/EN 60079-15, other than G2RL-1(A)-H and G2RL-1A-E-CV(-HA). Application examples: home appliances, office automation equipment and industrial machinery. RoHS compliant.

The G2RL-1-E DC24 is the general-purpose, flux-protected, high-capacity single-pole changeover (SPDT, 1c) model with a 24 VDC coil: 16.7 mA, 1,440 Ω, about 400 mW, picking up at 70% max. of rated voltage and dropping out at 10% min. It switches 16 A at 250 VAC or 24 VDC resistive and has the 8-terminal layout with each contact brought out on two pins.

The coil may be dropped to a lower holding voltage once the relay has picked up, but only after rated voltage has been on the coil for 100 ms or longer. The holding voltage must stay at 55% of rated or above, including any supply dips. On a -PW1 coil, 55% gives about 120 mW against about 400 mW at full voltage.

-PW1 models take a pulse-width-modulated coil drive, which lowers the holding current and with it the coil power. Rated voltage goes on the coil for at least 100 ms when the relay is switched on. OMRON verified the drive at rated voltage, duty 60% or above, frequency 10 kHz or above, and a diode Vf of 0.4 V or less; the actual equipment is to be checked under its own operating conditions.

The coil may see at most 130% of rated voltage at 85 °C. Against ambient temperature the limit is 180% up to 30 °C, then falls linearly, to about 128% at 85 °C where other types end, and on G2RL-1A-E-CV to about 110% at 105 °C. The maximum coil voltage is the highest value within a varying supply range, not a continuous voltage.
G2RL and G2R are both low-profile relays, but their ratings, switching capacity among them, are not the same; operation in the real application is to be confirmed before use.
The flux-protected case has two sealing holes, so the relay must not be boiled or immersed in water to clean it. Sealed versions are available from OMRON.
Sulfur-bearing or organic gases corrode the contact surfaces and can cause contact failure; such atmospheres are to be avoided.
